flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi utilities/sftpComponent/SftpConfig (SFTP server list), framework/services/comcrypt/helper/ComcryptWorkflowConfigResolver, resources/cron-schedules-prod.properties; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase and workflows/cas_integration (plus-get-court-case-info for PLUS). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no SPINE code
note: The story asks OCMS to send court case details to SPINE. None of the six repos contains spine, 'person of interest', 'screening of' or broker (0 hits in the src folders), and there is no SFTP server, cron, controller, DTO or tracking table for SPINE. The only related thing is court case data (ocms_court_case: notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason) served on demand to PLUS through plus-get-court-case-info; that is a pull by PLUS, not an interface to SPINE, so it is not counted. The sheet status 'Requirement given - Gen flow' is not supported by code. SPINE technical details and whether it is built outside the six repos: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The SPINE interface is not in the six repos. Ask URA/the team whether it is built in another repo or not started; the plus-get-court-case-info endpoint is not a substitute.

steps.step: OCMS has an interface to SPINE (connection, credentials, folder or endpoint)
steps.detail: The registered SFTP servers are only azureblob, ces, mha, toppan, icms, repccs, lta and cftvhub (SftpConfig.java:203-210); there is no SPINE entry. Case-insensitive grep for spine, 'person of interest', 'screening of' and broker in the src folders of all six repos (Java, properties, TS/TSX): 0 hits. No SPINE interface exists in the repo; whether it is built in another repo, cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS selects the court case details to send to SPINE
steps.detail: Court case data exists only in ocms_court_case with three columns: notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:18-31). The only external reader is plus-get-court-case-info, which answers per requested notice (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:637-639), so it is a pull by PLUS, not a case selection for SPINE. No query, job or DTO selects cases or builds a file/payload for SPINE.

steps.step: OCMS sends the court case details to SPINE on a schedule or by trigger
steps.detail: The crons in cron-schedules-prod.properties cover toppan, mha, lta, vhub, repccs, ces, notification, reports, sync and others (lines 62-351); there is no SPINE job. The COMCRYPT resolver only knows LTA, MHA, VHUB, TOPPAN, CES and REPCCS (ComcryptWorkflowConfigResolver.java:102-135). There is no SPINE trigger controller in ocmsadminapi or its cron proxy. No sending to SPINE exists.

steps.step: OCMS handles the SPINE response and records the cases sent so agencies can coordinate
steps.detail: There is no SPINE response/ACK receiver, tracking table or report. The existing tracking pattern belongs to vHub (ocms_offence_vhub, OCMS35.2) and does not touch court cases. The COMCRYPT decrypt/callback path has no SPINE branch (ComcryptWorkflowConfigResolver.java:102-135).
